claim: During a traditional forked bgsave or full sync, Valkey and Redis OSS memory usage can double or more. If FreeableMemory is insufficient to run a traditional forked operation, ElastiCache automatically switches to a forkless save mechanism, which uses much less memory but can add client latencies, especially with very large key/value items.

evidence.quote: During a traditional forked bgsave or full sync, Valkey and Redis OSS memory usage can double (or more), depending on the traffic load and pattern. If `FreeableMemory` is insufficient to run a traditional forked operation, Amazon ElastiCache automatically switches to a forkless save mechanism. This forkless mechanism uses much less memory, but can add client latencies — especially with very large key/value items.
